reference_text: Good day and welcome to the Tesla Q3 Earnings Conference Call. Joining us today are Elon Musk, Chief Executive Officer, and Vabhav Tunnijat, Chief Financial Officer. In the quarter, we achieved total revenue of $25.1 billion, up 8% year over year. Our energy storage business had record deployment of 6.9 GWh. Free cash flow reached $2.74 billion, supporting our ongoing expansion of AI compute clusters and vehicle manufacturing lines. We will now begin the question and answer session. Our first question comes from Adam Jonas with Morgan Stanley. Elon, what is the roadmap for autonomous cybercab production and full self-driving deployment? We are on track to begin volume production in 2026 with unmatched cost per passenger mile. Our next question comes from Dan Levy with Barclays. Vabhav, how should we model automotive gross margin excluding regulatory credits into next year? Cost reductions in raw materials and manufacturing efficiency continue to improve unit margins. Our next question comes from Pierre Feregu with New Street Research. Elon, how is megapack demand scaling relative to manufacturing capacity in Lathrop and Shanghai? Energy storage demand remains exceptionally robust, outpacing our automotive growth rate.
